rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.

Claude still has your brief" and L59 "this top claim" are the closest: session-artifact carve-out covers the brief; "this top claim" resolves to "generic top claims" at L55 in-chunk. rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L13 "what `team/what-goes-in.md` lets in" and L65 "the soft pages showed" are the closest backward refs: what-goes-in is an exercise in our-product-our-system.md (L124 table, apt101-what-goes-in); soft pages are produced in Phase 2 of this file, L51.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L9 "Three memories, one bet, three seats." is the closest verbless stack; it follows verbed sentences naming the set (L9 first two sentences), so the enumeration carve-out applies, and there is no guess/reveal demo beat in the file.
Smallest chunk is chunk 5 "Phase 5: Compare seats" L83-87: carries a full instruction (read out top claim and one soft page, name disagreement, do not settle it). No wait-state-only chunk.

L73 header "Phase 4: Let it find its own problems" against L77-81 (review for contradictions, missing sources, stale pages; approve/reject): header tells the chunk truly. L61 "Make it sharper, not longer" matches L65-71.

Closest: L7 "A chat forgets. A memory remembers." is a two-leg contrast, not a Not-X-Not-Y-Z; L29 "Push back, sharpen, add what's missing." triplet where every leg is a concrete action; no superlatives, no number-plus-retraction, no abstraction-noun stacks. grep -c 'most useful|one of the' on body = 0 by inspection of body_numbered.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L19 "Three beats: Claude helps you curate a plan, then pulls the content into `sources/`, then builds `memory/`" -- 'beat' is on the dialect list, but here it is communicating and is self-defined by the colon enumeration of three steps; harm (room cannot parse) absent. Maintainer-only dialect hits (L104 beat 6) sit below the cut. Suggestion filed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1 "Phase 1: Curate, ingest, build": L21 "**Keep the heavy reads under control.**" and L33 "**A note on what Claude reads.**" are two bolded lead sentences (6 words each, over the ~5-word handle cap) plus three UI-glyph "**+**" bolds in the L33 rt-desktop/rt-cowork spans, on a slide carrying 2+ bolded elements against a budget of 1. Harm (bold stops marking handles, dilutes the slide) present. Not a menu or lookup surface; not a mandated template shape. Chunk 6 "**What happened:**"/"**What's next:**" are recap labels, not charged.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: De-bold the L21 and L33 leads (plain prose or a <=5-word handle); fold into the Phase 1 split from rule 14.
